subject: Quote line items and SLI -> retention mapping for observability add-ons
messages:
From: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@edgeops.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — need clarity on quote and SLI mapping

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the proposal you sent — the team has reviewed the pricing deck and we have a couple of follow-ups before we pull this through procurement. Two items in particular: 

1) Quote structure: Your line items mix "Retention (GB-month)" and "Dashboard seats" with a single consolidated credit line. Procurement wants a clear split (e.g., ingestion vs storage vs seats) so they can justify the budget to finance. Can you provide a version that separates those components and shows an annualized number?

2) SLI mapping: We run strict SLIs for cold storage vs hot storage (30-day SLA for query latency on hot, 99.9% write durability for archival). We need to understand how Redwood's retention tiers map to those SLIs — specifically what we should expect at 7/30/90 days for trace rehydration times and sample coverage.

Attachments: I shared our compliance checklist with Lauren in case you need it for the SLI discussion.

Can we get a clear breakdown and a short doc that maps SLIs to your retention tiers? If possible, please include an example invoice line showing metered vs slab pricing for our projected volume (~4TB/month ingest).

Best,
Sarah
Head of Platform, EdgeOps

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@edgeops.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — need clarity on quote and SLI mapping

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear asks. Looping Ben (pricing) and Lauren (services) to give the appetite and a clean artifact. Summary of next steps from us: 

- Ben will produce a split quote that separates ingestion, storage (hot/warm/cold), and dashboard seats with an annualized column. He'll provide both metered and slab examples for 4TB/month.
- Lauren will draft a short SLI mapping doc (we'll attach a template) that maps retention tiers (7/30/90) to expected rehydrate latency and tracing sample coverage.
- We'll propose two commercial options: a 12-month commitment with a 10% discount on add-ons, or a 24-month commit with a 15% discount and an SLO uplift (faster hot-tier rehydrate).

Quick clarifying Qs for you: do you need the invoices broken into separate GL codes (ingest vs storage vs seats), or is a clearly labeled single invoice with line-item split OK? Also, is your procurement team okay with an initial pilot month of metered + then moving to slab commit?

I expect Ben will share the split quote by EOD Wednesday PST and Lauren will share the SLI mapping template shortly after.

Thanks — Hannah
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 30 Jun 2026 at 09:15 AM Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@edgeops.ai> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@edgeops.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — need clarity on quote and SLI mapping

Hi Sarah / Hannah,

Per Hannah's note, attached is a draft split quote and a pricing CSV with metered vs slab examples for ~4TB/month. Highlights: 

- Ingestion (hot path): $0.035 / GB ingested (includes continuous indexing for traces). For 4TB/month that's ~$1430/month.
- Hot storage (7-day tier): $0.12 / GB-month (fast rehydrate SLA target ~500ms median for traces, 95th < 2s under normal load).
- Warm storage (30-day tier): $0.03 / GB-month (rehydrate median ~2s, 95th ~5-8s).
- Cold storage (90+ day): $0.008 / GB-month (rehydrate via async job, typical rehydrate < 30m).
- Tracing storage surcharge: additional $0.005 / GB for full-span retention over ingest baseline (applies if you enable full-span persistence).
- Dashboards: $75 / seat / month or seat-bands (0-25, 26-100, 101+ with stepped pricing).

Commercial options (applies to add-ons only):
- Metered pilot: month-to-month, billed on usage. No minimum.
- 12-month slab commit: 10% discount on add-ons, commitment equals 12x expected monthly spend (flexible reallocation across ingestion/storage).
- 24-month slab commit: 15% discount + one-time migration credit and SLA uplift for hot-tier (target 250ms median rehydrate).

I've also attached a lightweight SLI mapping template (sli-mapping-template.xlsx) that Lauren will fill with measured targets and test instructions. Lauren — can you populate sample numbers for rehydrate during a simulated 10k qps ingestion spike?

Sarah — to your invoice question: we can provide either separate GL-coded invoices or a single invoice with clearly labeled lines; the latter is usually fine for finance but tell us your preference. Also happy to run a pilot month with metered billing and then convert to slab starting month 2 if that aligns with procurement.

Attachments: pricing-breakdown.csv, sli-mapping-template.xlsx, SOW-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Ben
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@edgeops.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — need clarity on quote and SLI mapping

Thanks Ben — this is exactly what procurement wanted to see. A couple of quick follow-ups: 

- For the pilot we'll take the metered month and have finance sign off on a 12-month slab commit starting the second month. That means we need a conversion clause (formula to convert consumed metered usage into committed baseline) — can you add that to SOW-v2?
- For the SLI mapping, the 500ms median for hot sounds reasonable; please populate the simulated spike numbers as Lauren requested so our SRE can vet.
- Regarding dashboards, can you include the stepped-seat pricing in the CSV with an example invoice for 35 seats?

If you can update the SOW and CSV so procurement has a clean doc to sign, we'll aim to get countersigned within two weeks. HubSpot deal updated with notes: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/7654321

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Sarah
Head of Platform, EdgeOps
(attachments referenced as stubs: SOW-v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), sli-mapping-template.xlsx (Excel, 80KB), pricing-breakdown.csv (CSV, 12KB))
